title: autoroute_receipt
$comment: A routing run is NOT a verdict. This receipt exists so that 'the router finished' can never be read as 'the board is routed correctly': it pins the board hash either side, the nets that were deliberately excluded because a human/highspeed-routing already owned them, the search budget that was in force, and the DRC result measured AFTER the import. Any of engine=none, tracks_after==tracks_before, or a missing drc_after makes the run NO_COVERAGE, never PASS.

scratch_path.$comment: The router runs on a scratch copy. The canonical board is only touched by the orchestrator's atomic promote, and only when this receipt is GREEN.

locked_nets.$comment: Nets the autorouter was FORBIDDEN to touch: differential pairs, length-matched groups, and anything highspeed-routing already routed. None of the three engines carries diff-pair or net-class semantics, so protection is by locking, not by configuration.

unrouted_nets.$comment: Every net the engine could not finish, WITH the reason string the tool reported. An empty list is only meaningful next to a non-empty candidate_nets.

engine.$comment: engine=none means no router ran. That is NO_COVERAGE and exits non-zero; it is never a clean board.

engine_report.$comment: Path to the engine's own JSON report (route-result/v1, topological-route-report/v1 or production-gate-report/v1). The receipt summarises; the engine report is the evidence.

budget.$comment: An unbounded autorouter is not allowed to run. grid_astar is bounded by max_nodes only (no time or bbox budget exists in the code); freerouting is bounded by wall-clock timeout_s plus an immediate kill on any Java exception; topological's search is finite by construction.

tracks_after.$comment: Measured on the board, not reported by the importer. ImportSpecctraSES can return True and add zero tracks when the padstacks do not match; tracks_after == tracks_before therefore means NOT routed.

drc_after.$comment: kicad-cli pcb drc AFTER the import, with --severity-all and --schematic-parity. ran=false forbids PASS.

locked_nets_untouched.$comment: Proven by comparing the geometry of every locked net before and after, not by trusting the lock flag.

status.$comment: GREEN requires: engine != none, tracks_after > tracks_before, unrouted_nets == [], drc_after.ran with 0 violations and 0 unconnected, and locked_nets_untouched == true. Anything else is at most CONFIRM.
